item.description: PoseWear is a free, open-source reference library by atuizz: searchable pose, realistic/anime outfit, and portrait sets with bilingual prompts, plus in-browser AI try-on using your own API key. item.title: cutaway: From One Picture to a Take-Apart 3D Mechanical Model
item.description: HeLi (@HeLi8866) highlights the open-source Claude Code skill cutaway (Nyxera0x/cutaway): give it one reference image and Claude rebuilds a detailed, take-apart 3D mechanical model in Three.js from code. He tested it with a ChatGPT render and the word "octopus," and got a 10-blade mechanical iris, a borosilicate glass dome that lifts and flips, and eight arms on a 48-tooth hub; the cutaway film drops a part every 3 seconds and is fully disassembled by about 19 seconds. The skill is MIT-licensed (~380 stars at capture) and was documented by @isagi1000x; install with npx skills add Nyxera0x/cutaway -g -a claude-code.

item.title: Tabbit 万字复盘：做了一年半 Browser Use，我们学到的苦涩教训
item.description: - Tabbit 团队复盘了一年半的 Browser Use 探索：早期通过截图、DOM 和逐步点击，让 Agent 像人一样操作浏览器，但这种 GUI 路线始终面临速度慢、定位不准、成功率不高等问题。 - 随着模型编程能力提升，团队发现让 Agent 直接编写并执行代码，可以利用循环、条件和状态处理复杂任务。Codex 曾通过代码循环完成并核查 200 多条后台配置，促使 Tabbit 转向 Coding-first。 - Tabbit CLI 以 Playwright 为主要接口，并保留 DOM-CUA、视觉操作和 CDP 等能力；团队的基准测试显示，其在所测任务中的正确率最高、成本最低、速度也较快。文章也指出，小模型 Jev 适合特定的页面识别和定位环节，但目前不足以独立完成开放式长程任务。 - 作者将这一转变视为《The Bitter Lesson》的体现：精心设计的工具和脚手架可能随着模型进步成为限制，通用的代码执行能力更能适应复杂任务。未来 WebMCP 可能让网站主动向 Agent 提供结构化业务工具。

item.title: cospan: an async delegation protocol that lets coding agents orchestrate each other
item.description: - Cospan：让不同编码代理统一协作。 它通过异步委派协议连接 Antigravity、Codex、Claude Code、DeepSeek Harness 等工具。项目将“模型 × 执行环境”视为协作单元，代理可在后台派发任务、非阻塞地查看进度，并按需获取结果或完整执行记录。 - 核心用法与场景： 通过 /cospan-<harness>、Claude Code 中的 /cospan:<harness>，或 Codex 中的 $cospan:<harness> 指派任务，并可指定模型、推理强度和超时。支持并行代码审查、跨模型方案评估、浏览器与 GUI 测试、并发检查，以及从规划到审核的完整研究流程。Antigravity 和 DeepSeek Harness 还提供统一侧边栏，用于查看后台任务、问答结果和 Git worktree。 - 安装与支持环境： 需要 Node.js 20 或更高版本，以及所需的代理命令行工具。支持 Antigravity、Codex、Claude Code 和 DeepSeek Harness，并提供手动安装、升级和诊断方法；安装后可能需要重启 Claude Code 或 Codex。 - 路线图与许可： 计划支持通过 SSH 在不同机器之间异步委派任务。项目受 MIT 许可证保护，并受到 agy-staff 项目的启发。

item.title: Matt Pocock's software-factory skill: a shared vocabulary for designing a software factory
item.description: software-factory is an in-progress skill in Matt Pocock's skills repo (pinned at commit abeeaf9): a shared glossary for designing a software factory, a system of agents that turns tickets, PRs and schedules into merged code. It defines Task, Trigger, Run and Runner plus five service slots (ticket tracker, ticket source, git host, orchestrator, observability platform), five questions to answer per task, and a 'start slow' rule with three brakes: automated checks, automated review, human review.

item.title: NSH (Native Shell): a Rust native UI framework for every platform
item.description: - Native Shell（NSH）是一个基于 Rust 的跨平台原生 UI 框架，支持 iOS、Android、macOS、Windows、Linux、GPUI、终端和 Web；可用 Rust、TSX 或两者结合构建应用。 - NSH 共享组件、状态、逻辑、响应式引擎和布局，同时使用各平台原生视图与交互，并支持应用自定义视觉设计；应用既可独立打包，也可嵌入现有原生应用。 - 框架支持运行时加载经签名的 TSX 模块，并在由宿主配置能力的沙箱中运行；提供热更新、无界面追踪、AI 生成界面支持及统一的 nsh 命令行工具。 - 项目采用 Apache-2.0 许可证，提供 Rust 与 TSX 示例、文档和 AI 编程代理技能；安装方式及各平台运行要求见官网 nsh.dev。

item.title: Anthropic 官方架构指南：如何构建 7×24 小时常驻 Agent
item.description: - 常驻智能体不需要持续运行大模型：它可在事件到来时被唤醒，完成工作、保存状态后休眠。 - 系统由事件收件箱、定时器、记忆、权限和发件箱五部分组成，分别负责接收触发、安排任务、跨次运行保存状态、约束行动，以及交付结果。 - 事件收件箱应持久保存事件、通过唯一标识去重，并控制并发；定时器将到期任务送入收件箱，进入统一处理流程。 - 设计时应按需加载持久记忆、保护凭据并审查高风险操作，同时控制通知频率；需要用户批准时，可保存状态并暂停，待用户回应后再恢复运行。

item.title: Claude Code 内部分享：代码都由 Claude 来完成后，怎么做验证呢？
item.description: - Claude Code 团队约 90% 的代码由 Claude 编写并审查；可靠的验证机制能让人从逐行检查代码差异，转向定义完成标准并审核验证证据。 - 优先采用端到端测试、属性测试和差分测试；测试应稳定、快速，并尽可能让 Agent 在真实运行的应用中验证改动。 - 团队通过 verify 技能、三轮失败后转交人工、按代码差异触发检查、基于固定规则审查，以及先观察再强制执行的新门禁，提升验证质量。 - 定期评估和清理审查规则，将漏掉的 bug 转化为可复用规则，并确保改动无法篡改用于评判自身的检查。

item.title: Lody: Run your coding agents in parallel, safely, and share them with the team
item.description: Lody is a shared control plane for coding agents. Use the Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, or Kimi Code subscriptions you already pay for (plus any ACP-compatible agent, or an API key) and run multiple sessions on your own machines. One conversation can orchestrate sub-agents across machines, agents, and repos — parallel multi-OS tests, review-then-fix loops, and cross-repo dependency fixes. A single npx lody daemon start keeps a server or home desktop online so you can dispatch work from a phone, the web, a script, or CI. Sessions can be handed off in the team workspace (machines stay private until you share them). You can also inspect usage by member, manage PRs and CI inside a session, and check progress or permissions from the Dynamic Island.

item.description: - 文章指出，AI 往往倾向于推荐热门、熟悉的选项，长期使用可能压缩人们选择的多样性，让不同人的选择趋于相似。 - 研究显示，AI 辅助写作和决策会降低作品与选择的独特性；个性化推荐虽能缓解人与人之间的趋同，却可能进一步缩小个人自身的选择范围。 - 人们通常乐于接受 AI 流畅、稳妥的建议，但这种顺滑也可能让生活变得可预测，减少意外发现与个性表达。 - 为保留多样性和审美自主，人们可以主动索取意外选项，并在某些决定上不依赖 AI，给偏离主流和犯错留出空间。

item.title: 当大学生不抬头、不听课、不交流

item.title: leaf: Read papers and review diffs in the terminal, then send a selection to your coding agent
item.description: leaf is an open-source terminal reader (v0.16, MIT, written in Rust; install with curl -fsSL https://leaf.dipxsy.app | sh or cargo install leaf-reader). Give it a paper, book, doc, URL, image, diff, or GitHub PR and it lays out a clean page in the terminal — figures and tables stay in place, and every document reopens where you stopped. Select lines and press @ to send the question, file, and line context to Claude Code, Codex, or opencode running beside you. Review diffs side by side, comment, and send them to your agent or GitHub; review an agent's plan before it builds (approve / approve with notes / request changes). Also a native Rex plugin. Highlights, read-aloud, wrap-aware search, and mermaid diagrams stay in the terminal. Everything lives in one local file — no account, no sync.

item.title: Anthropic on Always-on Agent Architecture (Xiaohongshu note)
item.description: - This is a Xiaohongshu recap by "AI拯救打工人（幻觉版）" of Anthropic's article "Building always-on agents," not the official text. - The note treats always-on as a user experience: the agent mostly sleeps, wakes on events or timers, writes state back after a short run, and does not burn tokens around the clock. - It recounts five primitives — Event Inbox, Timers, Memory, Permissions (including deferred tool calls), and Outbox — and the author adds that long-running capabilities may settle into the harness, with a possible loop of run, record, evaluate, distill, and improve.

item.title: One Command to Keep Your Multi-Agent System in Order (troupe)
item.description: - troupe is a terminal orchestrator for coding agents: one approved plan, each role in its own window, git worktree and branch, on Claude Code or Codex. - It handles parallelism by structure: file ranges live in the plan, overlaps run in series, only the orchestrator merges, and acceptance is 3–6 human-checkable Done when lines. - Humans stay at two gates — no start without an approved plan, no push without consent. Review only blocks failed acceptance, data loss, security issues, or broken existing behavior, and is limited to one fix round. Install with one command, no config.

item.title: Agent Memory Isn't About Storing More: Anthropic's Four Layers and Dreaming (@Smartpigai)
item.description: Smartpig (@Smartpigai) walks through Anthropic’s engineering post “The components of agent memory.” Many agent-memory projects only store chat logs, embed them, and retrieve with vector search — an approach he says overcomplicates things from the start. The core claim: memory is not about storing more, but about knowing what is worth remembering, when to recall it, and when to forget. The post splits memory into four layers: Transcripts (raw event logs), Memory Notes (experience notes that include a conclusion and why it is trustworthy), Memory Representations (a background wiki that can be navigated), and Injected Context (preload what matters; retrieve the rest; Claude Code Auto Memory loads only the first 200 lines or 25KB of MEMORY.md). The technically interesting piece is Dreaming: idle compute reviews past tasks, distills reusable rules, corrects mistakes against raw transcripts, organizes a wiki, cleans contradictions, and decides what to inject next time. Results cited: CL-Bench database task, Opus 5.5 from 0.655 without memory to 0.838; in Pokémon, Sonnet 3.7 saved 413 files and earned 1 badge, while Fable 5 kept about 10 files and earned 4; on an enterprise corpus of ~350k docs / 420M tokens, search alone scored 53%, wiki+search 61%, saving ~20k tokens per question. His takeaway: the next generation of agent memory is less about RAG and more about memory lifecycle management. A reasonable engineering stack is Event Log + Structured Memory + Knowledge Wiki + Retrieval + Background Consolidation (Dreaming).

item.title: Grok Bot + Obsidian: An Automatic, Evolvable Second Brain (@Jackywine)
item.description: Jackywine (@Jackywine) recaps a month of handing his local Obsidian vault to a Grok Bot now named “Jackywine Digital Garden” (formerly “Obsidian Apprentice”; https://x.ai/bot/gdq_d-d9OCnnREs3VwGdV). A read-only diagnosis on Sept 17 found ~5,488 markdown files, nearly 40% empty stubs in the root, and ~8,000 unresolved links — the illness he named “collecting disguised as thinking.” He set four guardrails: file over app, AI output only into AI outputs/, atomic flomo imports, and sparse properties. In October he instituted a “content iron rule” (don’t write what you haven’t lived), stopped a stripped wikilink pack and an idle daily linking report, and wrote apprentice rules. On Nov 6 he renamed and split roles (flomo as memory, Obsidian as disk), walked onboarding one question at a time, wired up obsidian-cli, re-diagnosed (5,661 notes; unresolved links down to 4,747; stubs still ~43%), shipped an evergreen-note skill, and open-sourced jackywine-digital-garden-skills (7 skills, MIT). Thesis: a bot’s strength is that it can act; his most valuable decisions were what he forbade it to do. Judgment stays human. The article includes diagnosis, onboarding, apprentice, evergreen-note, related-notes, and orphan-notes prompts.

item.title: Nothing to Hide: iA on AI watermarks — putting writers back in control
item.description: - 欧洲新的 AI 透明度规则旨在保护消费者免受机器生成文本的操纵，但 AI 水印可能让读者变成监视者，助长恐惧与不信任。iA 认为，阅读和写作应当丰富、愉悦并解放人，而不是让人担心被指控。 - AI 水印依靠文本中隐藏的生成模式；检测器可能误判人类写作、漏掉 AI 文本，也可能因改写而失效。持续检查文本是否由 AI 生成，会损害读者与作者之间的信任，使写作变成躲避指控的游戏。 - AI 也能用于准备、讨论、拼写和事实检查，以及精简文字。关键在于透明地标记 AI 的贡献，并由作者重新审视、改写生成内容，让文字真正表达自己的意思；iA Writer 可标记并区分人类与 AI 撰写的部分。 - iA 主张将人类与机器生成的文字清楚区分，把创作控制权交还作者。使用 AI 时，应具体说明它如何、在哪里参与，并像引用其他文本一样对待 AI 生成内容；iA Writer 的作者标记功能旨在帮助看清各方的贡献，而非赞美或谴责 AI。

item.title: 框架选不对，Claude 开发成本多一倍：前端十年框架膨胀，终于有人买单了
item.description: - AI 代理使用不同 JavaScript 框架构建同一宝可梦应用，开发成本、Token 消耗和时间差异显著，Hono+htmx 成本最低约 2.67 美元，Angular 成本最高近 5 美元。 - 开发时间和 Token 使用与框架复杂度相关，Angular 开发时间约为 17 分钟，Token 消耗约 976 万，约为 Hono+htmx 的两倍以上。 - 性能指标（Lighthouse、TBT、LCP）总体差距不大，但框架影响代码体积和主线程阻塞时间，Angular 的 TBT 达 103 ms，远高于多数框架。 - 代码行数也反映维护成本，Hono+htmx 仅约 1370 行代码，是所有方案中最少的，Angular 则超过 2000 行。

item.title: The Edge-Play Economy Isn't About Sexual Repression: Relationships Can't Grow, So the Market Sells Intimacy in Parts (Zhineng Luzhang, Bilibili)
item.description: A 28-minute Bilibili monologue by Zhineng Luzhang. Paid flirtation is booming in China: 'business rafting', pool-table hostesses, hiking escorts, romance role-play, 'sweet duo' gaming partners. The host argues this isn't sexual repression, since porn is oversupplied and Japan has both abundant porn and the most paid companionship. What people lack is a relationship where someone looks back at them. Shared neighborhoods and idle time have faded, and modern freedom to not choose and to exit breeds uncertainty. So the market sells intimacy item by item, and what it really sells is certainty. Drawing on Eva Illouz and Byung-Chul Han, he says gacha and otome games make bodies and feelings transparent and erase the Other. Delete the pain, and you delete what makes love moving.

item.title: From "Big Results" to "Big Hongguo": When Hard Work Stops Paying Off (Zhixing Tavern E255)
item.description: A 69-minute episode of the Chinese podcast Zhixing Tavern, hosted by Yubai with guests Wen Yifei and Yang Tiannan. Wen argues that four things were confirmed around 2023: negative CPI, the housing peak, population decline and year one of AI. China moved from undersupply to overproduction, so the work ethic of "work harder, get luckier" turned into "work harder, just work harder". Wealth now flows to data centers and high-tech exports instead of ordinary workers, and local finance is tied to production. AI gives the world standard answers, so pain no longer fuels meaning. Blame keeps shrinking, from the era to elites to oneself to 30-second short dramas on Hongguo. The way out is creating, caring and passing things on, and to stop waiting.

item.title: agent-desktop: Vercel Labs open-sources desktop computer use via OS accessibility trees
item.description: agent-desktop is Vercel Labs' open-source (Apache-2.0) Rust CLI and C library that gives any agent—Claude Code, Codex, Cursor—desktop computer use through OS accessibility trees instead of screenshots. Snapshots return JSON with a ref per actionable element; agents act on refs and re-snapshot to verify, with STALE_REF on UI changes. Headless by default (no cursor or focus stealing), 56 operational commands on macOS/Windows/Linux, and self-reported 78–96% token savings via skeleton traversal. Web pages stay with agent-browser.
